title: From Individual Experience to Collective Evidence: A Reporting-Based Framework for Identifying Systemic Harms
summary: Released LIL count test omits paper's multiplicity factor, violating FWER in an independent i.i.d. construction. Adaptive power proof uses unjustified independent-sum Hoeffding step. Absolute-incidence corollary drops scale factor.
limitations: No author-code execution or empirical reproduction.
Inspected snapshot not proven to be historical experiment commit; reported discoveries not declared false.
External regret theorem not retrieved; no complete repaired power theorem certified.
Raw data, weights and result archives not downloaded.
Joint prevalence and stationarity effects not quantified.
README arXiv link observed without version comparison/global erratum search.
